headings.usage: All section titles, hero text, card headers

visual_enhancers.textures: Use noise overlay opacity-5 mix-blend-overlay on solid backgrounds

layout_strategies.landing_page: Parallax scrolling with star fields. Hero section must be immersive.
layout_strategies.bento_grid: Use for 'Full Results' dashboard. Uneven grid cells for different soul aspects.
layout_strategies.form_ritual: Single input focus or step-by-step 'ritual' progression rather than a boring form list.

buttons.primary: bg-transparent border border-[#C5A059] text-[#C5A059] hover:bg-[#C5A059] hover:text-[#0F0518] transition-all duration-500 uppercase tracking-widest shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(197,160,89,0.3)]

cards.style: Glassmorphism with 1px gold border (opacity 20%). Hover state increases border opacity and adds inner glow.

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b border-[#C5A059]/30 focus:border-[#C5A059] text-xl text-center text-[#E0D9F6] outline-none placeholder:text-[#E0D9F6]/30 transition-all font-light

assets_instructions.icons: Use lucide-react with thin stroke-width (1px) for a delicate, refined look. Use Star, Moon, Sun, Sparkles icons.
assets_instructions.particles: Install 'tsparticles' and 'react-tsparticles'. Create a 'StarField' component that renders subtle moving white dots behind the content.

landing.vibe: Immersive, heavy use of scroll animations.

form.ui: Center screen, one question at a time (Typeform style but mystical).

free_preview.goal: Show high value, blur the rest. Make the user feel 'seen' instantly.
free_preview.paywall: Blur the 'Deep Soul Analysis' sections with a glass overlay and a lock icon.

full_results.layout: Tabbed interface or long scroll with sticky nav.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'framer-motion' for scroll reveals and entry animations.
Ensure the Free Preview page is accessible BEFORE payment.
Use the provided image URLs as background images with low opacity overlays.
Do NOT use gradients for text unless it is a very large headline.
Avoid the infinity symbol as requested. Use constellations, stars, or simple geometric lines.
Ensure all text contrast meets WCAG AA standards, especially gold on dark purple.

universal_guidelines.spacing: Use p-12 or p-24 for section spacing. Do not cram content.
universal_guidelines.typography: Don't use Inter. Use Quicksand for body.
universal_guidelines.buttons: No solid block buttons. Use ghost buttons with borders or glowing effects.
universal_guidelines.interactions: All interactive elements must have a hover state that changes color or glow.
universal_guidelines.mobile: Ensure font sizes scale down on mobile. p-4 padding on mobile containers.
